analysis.evidence: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי שֵׁם means “These are the sons of Shem.” The name identifies the ancestor whose descendants the verse groups by clan, language, land, and nation. The source gloss “Paran” is incorrect.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew proper noun without a prefix or suffix. It completes the construct phrase בְנֵי שֵׁם, “sons of Shem.”
